meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用访谈式提问帮您打磨计划与设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常常需要把不成熟的想法梳理得清晰可行
copy.tagline_en: Hone your plan or design through relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sharpen rough ideas into clear plans.

howto.what: 启动 /grilling 后,Claude 会变成不留情面的面试官,围绕你的计划或设计连续追问,挑出薄弱点,直到方案变得更严密。
howto.when: 当你发出 /grilling 命令时触发;它不是自动的,需要你主动发起。

say.text: /grilling,请严苛拷问我的产品发布计划。
say.note: Claude 会不断追问,逼你把每个细节想清楚。

say.text: /grilling,用连环提问帮我找出方案里的漏洞。
say.note: 它会抓住风险点逐层深挖。

say.text: /grilling,针对我的项目设计做一场压力测试。
say.note: 相当于一次高强度演练。

howto.what_en: When you run /grilling, Claude acts as a relentless interviewer, firing questions about your plan or design until you sharpen it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you issue the /grilling command; it is not automatic—you must start it.

say_en.text: /grilling, grill my product launch plan hard.
say_en.note: Claude keeps probing until you clarify.

say_en.text: /grilling, poke holes in my proposal with rapid questions.
say_en.note: It dives deeper into each risk.
